chunks.title: Annual leave allowance
chunks.content: Employees receive 25 annual leave days each calendar year. In Finnish: tyontekijoilla on 25 vuosilomapaivaa vuodessa. Leave requests are approved by the manager before the planned absence.

chunks.title: Payroll and onboarding
chunks.content: Payroll is processed monthly. New employees complete onboarding, equipment collection, and mandatory security training during the first week.

chunks.title: Processor requirements
chunks.content: The krav galler for personuppgiftsbitraden include documented instructions, confidentiality commitments, audit assistance, subprocessors approved in writing, and deletion or return of personal data at termination.

chunks.title: Restore procedure after failed deployment
chunks.content: The restore procedure after a failed deployment is to stop traffic to the failed release, roll back the application image, restore the database from the latest verified backup if migration rollback is required, run health checks, and reopen traffic.

chunks.title: Deployment observability
chunks.content: Release owners review latency, error rate, queue depth, and audit log ingestion for thirty minutes after deployment.
